fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The way is athar, not speculation
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Zurʿah and Abū Ḥātim said: Our way and our choice is following the Messenger ﷺ, his Companions and the Tābiʿīn, and holding fast to the ways of the people of the athar.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes speculative dīn. The safe way is transmission, the understanding of the Ṣaḥābah, and attachment to the early imāms.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah, Iʿtiqād Abī Zurʿah wa Abī Ḥātim.
immutable.scholar: Abū Zurʿah und Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī
